steps.en: Install and start the server (or run the Docker image with a data volume)
steps.zh: 安装并启动服务（或带数据卷跑 Docker 镜像）

steps.en: Open the page and sign up; the first account becomes the administrator
steps.zh: 打开页面注册，第一个账号就是管理员

steps.en: Point it at Ollama or an OpenAI-compatible API
steps.zh: 把它指向 Ollama 或 OpenAI 兼容接口

steps.en: Lists every backend's models in one picker and stores users and chats in SQLite
steps.zh: 把各后端的模型列进同一个选择器，用户和对话存进 SQLite

steps.en: Upload a document, or pull one into the chat with #, and ask about it
steps.zh: 上传文档，或在对话里用 # 引入文档，然后提问

steps.en: Extracts, chunks, and embeds the file, then puts the matching passages into the prompt
steps.zh: 抽取、切块、向量化文件，把命中的段落塞进提示词

value.en: A shared ChatGPT-style page over your own models that answers from your own files, with nothing leaving your network
value.zh: 一个共享的 ChatGPT 式页面接自己的模型，能按自己的文件回答，数据不出内网

sources: README.md @ main 2026-10-08 (pip install open-webui; open-webui serve; http://localhost:8080; docker run ... -v open-webui:/app/backend/data ... ghcr.io/open-webui/open-webui:main; OLLAMA_BASE_URL; OPENAI_API_KEY; '#' command loads documents into chat; HF_HUB_OFFLINE=1)
https://docs.openwebui.com/getting-started/quick-start/ ('That first account is the administrator'; default SQLite and local files)

backend/open_webui/env.py @ main (DATABASE_URL defaults to sqlite:///{DATA_DIR}/webui.db); backend/open_webui/config.py @ main (VECTOR_DB defaults to chroma; RAG_EMBEDDING_MODEL defaults to sentence-transformers/all-MiniLM-L6-v2)
